## Setup

Quarto and R Markdown keep their options in the chunk's header, and Quarto in lines that start with `#|`:

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(palmerpenguins)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-bills
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.hist(penguins["bill_length_mm"])
```

The mean bill is `r round(mean(penguins$bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` mm long, as @fig-bills shows.
